main_body: Orange autumn tree: a rounded multi-lobed leaf canopy (rows ~1-33) on a short brown trunk with a root flare (rows 31-44) and a few grass tufts at the base.
top_band: Canopy lobes: light orange highlights (rows ~3-8) on top of each lobe, stepping down to mid orange and dark red-brown underside shadow (rows ~28-33). Top-lit domed clumps. Trunk column starts at row ~32.
evidence: Organic tree. The canopy is made of overlapping domed lobes whose light upper surfaces read as lit tops, with dark shaded undersides that overhang the trunk, giving a volumetric 3/4 reading comparable to the Beodeul tree references. The trunk is a vertical form with a flared base. No isometric side face is drawn. There is no hard front-edge line, which is natural for foliage, but the dark underside shadow beneath the canopy does act as an eave shadow.

style.evidence: The canopy uses about 5 orange-to-dark-red steps with clump-shaped lobes and a few yellow highlight pixels. Outlines are a dark red-brown that follows the canopy, and dark brown next to the trunk, not near-black. The trunk has 4 browns with vertical grain and a flared root base. Texture is blocky: the canopy clumps are broad shaded masses without the fine per-leaf dots seen in the references, and the trunk is a simple column with less root detail. It is slightly less rich than the references but has no large flat fills and would sit acceptably next to them.
